summary_en: This randomized study compares OT-101 added to mFOLFIRINOX with mFOLFIRINOX alone in advanced, unresectable or metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. OT-101 is an antisense drug given by IV on Days 4-7 of a 14-day cycle, and mFOLFIRINOX starts on Day 1 of each cycle; the total number of cycles is not stated. The study measures efficacy and safety, but the main outcome measure is not stated; the study is Phase 2/3.
summary_es: Este estudio aleatorizado compara OT-101 añadido a mFOLFIRINOX con mFOLFIRINOX solo, en cáncer de páncreas avanzado, no resecable o metastásico (adenocarcinoma ductal). OT-101 es un fármaco antisentido que se administra por vía intravenosa los días 4 a 7 de un ciclo de 14 días, y mFOLFIRINOX comienza el día 1 de cada ciclo; el número total de ciclos no se indica. El estudio evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad, pero la medida de resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de fase 2/3.
who_for: Advanced, unresectable or metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue biopsy or documented history
Age 18 years or older, with signed informed consent
Adequate blood, liver and kidney function, and life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Pancreatic islet, acinar cell, lymphoma, sarcoma, biliary tree or cystadenocarcinoma tumors
Active HIV or active hepatitis A, B or C infection
